description: Watchdog scores, verdicts and a ranking for 2-10 tokens on any chains side by side in one request. Priced per mint at $0.0015 — cheaper per mint than get_token_snapshot since the payload is lighter. Good for screening a watchlist in one call instead of one call per token.

mints.description: Token addresses, 2 to 10. Use a plain address (chain auto-detected) or chain:address such as base:0x... to pin the chain.

title: Compare tokens
